items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I think it was Chubby Jackson, Carmen Cavalerra was with Mal Hallett's band

ctx.x: Oh Gene. Well the thing that I always say

about Gene is, See, any time, I've been knowing Gene way when he was with Mal Hallett's band, I was with Blanche Calloway. I met Gene in Boston, Mass, the New England states. Gene, and I think it was Chubby Jackson, Carmen Cavalerra was with Mal Hallett's band, and that was 1933, that's how long I been knowing Gene, up through the years when he first joined Benny and just everything, Gene knew me when I was with Benny Carter, and Willie Bryant and all up through those years. But, when the fact still remains, when…
Just about everything you hear about him is like that.
